name: tigergrid
description: A contribution graph of your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and AI-assisted commits

scripts.svg:all: mkdir -p out && for m in prompts sessions tokens commits ai; do bun src/cli.ts -w 53 -m $m --svg out/tigergrid-$m.svg > /dev/null; done && echo "wrote out/tigergrid-*.svg"
